non_operations.none: The request is outside the vault's reach, or asks for something no operation covers; refuse.
non_operations.clarify: The request names a referent that resolves to more than one thing, or omits a required slot; ask one question.

operations.name: agenda_upcoming
operations.description: List events on the calendar inside a date window, ordered by start time, regardless of what they are about.
example_utterances: what's on my calendar next week
what do I have on Friday

operations.name: agenda_search
operations.description: Find events whose title or notes mention a topic, across all dates rather than inside a window.

topic.description: Words that appear in the event title or its notes.

window.description: Optional date phrase narrowing the topic search.

example_utterances: search my calendar for anything about onboarding

operations.name: agenda_day_context
operations.description: Give the full picture for one specific day: its events, the tasks due on it, and who is expected.
example_utterances: what does my Thursday look like
give me the rundown for tomorrow

operations.name: people_at
operations.description: List the people attending one named event; the answer is a set of people, not the event itself.

event.description: An event phrase: its title, or a title plus a date word.

example_utterances: who's coming to the design review
who accepted the sprint planning invite

operations.name: agenda_create_event
operations.description: Put a new event on the calendar at a stated time, optionally inviting people.

attendees.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

example_utterances: schedule a 1:1 with Neha tomorrow at 3
put a dentist appointment on Friday morning
book a retro next Tuesday with the Initech folks

operations.name: agenda_reschedule
operations.description: Move an event that already exists to a different time, leaving its title and guest list alone.

event.description: An event phrase, or a reference into the last result.

example_utterances: move the design review to Thursday

operations.name: agenda_cancel_event
operations.description: Take an event off the calendar entirely, rather than changing when it happens.

event.description: An event phrase, or a reference into the last result.

operations.name: agenda_attendee_add
operations.description: Invite more people to an event that is already scheduled, without changing its time.

event.description: An event phrase, or a reference into the last result.

people.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

example_utterances: add Neha to the design review
invite everyone at Initech to the offsite
also invite those people to the retro

operations.name: tasks_due
operations.description: List open tasks sliced by when they are due, without regard to what they are about.

window.description: A date phrase bounding the due date.

example_utterances: what do I have to finish today

operations.name: tasks_about
operations.description: Find tasks whose title mentions a topic, whenever they happen to be due.

topic.description: Words appearing in the task title.

example_utterances: find my tasks about the migration
anything on my list mentioning invoices
do I have a task about the visa

operations.name: tasks_by_project
operations.description: List the tasks filed under one named project or section, which is where they live rather than what they say.

operations.name: tasks_for_people
operations.description: List tasks assigned to a person or a group of people, resolving the group phrase in code.

people.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

example_utterances: what is Neha on the hook for
tasks assigned to the people at Initech
what do the design review attendees owe me

operations.name: tasks_add
operations.description: Create a new task with a title, optionally with a due date, project, or assignee.

assignee.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

example_utterances: remind me to renew the domain on Friday

new task: book flights, due next week

operations.name: tasks_complete
operations.description: Mark an existing task done; it changes a task's status rather than its schedule.

task.description: A task phrase, or a reference into the last result.

operations.name: tasks_set_due
operations.description: Change when a task is due, leaving its title and status alone.

task.description: A task phrase, or a reference into the last result.

example_utterances: push the domain renewal to next month

operations.name: tasks_assign
operations.description: Hand a task to a person, leaving its due date alone.

task.description: A task phrase, or a reference into the last result.

people.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

example_utterances: assign the invoice task to Marcus

operations.name: people_find

name.description: A first name, full name, or nickname.

operations.name: people_profile
operations.description: Show one person's stored detail — channels, company, important dates — for a person already pinned down.

person.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

operations.name: people_log_interaction

operations.name: people_add_note

person.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

add to Marcus's card that he prefers mornings

people.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

new note in Work: rework the onboarding

operations.name: notes_append

append that to my migration note

operations.name: photos_of_people
operations.description: Find photos in which named people appear, resolving the person or group phrase in code.

docs.description: A document phrase, or a reference into the last result.

people.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').

people.description: A noun phrase resolved in code, never an id: a name, a group ('people at Initech'), or a reference into the last result ('those people').
